sscReconciliations.findings: Sub-Inspector (Executive) in Delhi Police is recruited centrally by SSC through the annual SSC CPO Examination. Delhi regional discovery routes to ssc_cpo. Duplicate delhi_police_si mission is suppressed from materialization.

Constable (Executive) Male & Female in Delhi Police is an independently distinct examination conducted exclusively for Delhi Police by SSC under a dedicated MOU/scheme. It retains its own dedicated mission identity.
